entities.name: Bark Cloth (Tapa)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Made by pounding the inner bark of paper mulberry trees into thin, flexible sheets. Tapa cloth was the primary textile of Polynesia, decorated with elaborate geometric patterns using natural dyes.
